hint.cipher: Shadowsocks cipher name, e.g. aes-256-gcm; validated by CLI
settings.notice: Only interface preferences are saved in DMS. VPN settings are managed by the Mullvad daemon.
form.hint: Fields marked * are required. Empty optional fields keep existing values. Read the current state below before making changes.
invalid.arguments: Application arguments must be a JSON array of strings, for example ["--new-window"].
unsupported: This operation or one of its options is unavailable in CLI {version}.
status.notice: CLI {version} · Settings come from the daemon
mock.notice: SIMULATION · CLI {version} · No VPN changes are executed
confirm.title: Confirm operation
confirm.connection: This changes your VPN connection and may briefly interrupt network access.
confirm.account: This changes account access or devices, or redeems a voucher. Creating an account logs in immediately. Logout or device revocation may stop the tunnel; vouchers cannot be reused.
confirm.servers: This changes relay selection, overrides or custom lists. It may reconnect the tunnel or remove an existing list/override.
confirm.tunnel: This changes tunnel routing, encryption or anticensorship. It may interrupt the connection; incorrect allowed IPs can block access.
confirm.network: This changes network or DNS policy. Lockdown blocks internet while disconnected; DNS and LAN changes affect reachability.
confirm.split: This bypasses or restores VPN protection for a process. A launched app and its descendants may send traffic outside the VPN.
confirm.api: This changes API access methods or proxy credentials. Removing or disabling a working method may prevent API access.
confirm.maintenance: Review this maintenance action carefully. Import and resets change settings; factory reset also logs out and removes caches/logs. Export a backup before resetting.
hint.cidrs: Comma separated IPs/CIDRs; empty restores defaults
hint.location: Country code, any, or relay hostname
error.binary: Mullvad executable is missing or cannot run
error.file: File could not be read or saved; exports refuse overwrites
op.reconnect: Reconnect to any matching VPN relay
op.status: Return the state of the VPN tunnel
op.version: Show information about the current Mullvad version and available versions
op.reset-settings: Reset settings only, but remain logged in and keep logs and caches
op.import-settings: Apply a JSON patch generated by 'export-settings'
op.export-settings: Export a JSON patch based on the current settings
op.account.create: Create and log in on a new account
op.account.logout: Log out of the current account
op.account.get: Display information about the current account
op.account.list-devices: List devices associated with an account
op.account.revoke-device: Revoke a device associated with an account
op.lockdown-mode.get: Display the current lockdown mode setting
op.lan.get: Display the current local network sharing setting
op.api-access.get: Display the current API access method
op.api-access.edit: Edit a custom API access method
field.name: Name
op.api-access.remove: Remove a custom API access method
op.api-access.use: Try to use a specific API access method (If the API is unreachable, reverts back to the previous access method)
op.api-access.test: Try to reach the Mullvad API using a specific access method
op.split-tunnel.list: List all processes that are excluded from the tunnel
op.split-tunnel.add: Add a PID to exclude from the tunnel
op.split-tunnel.delete: Stop excluding a PID from the tunnel
op.split-tunnel.clear: Stop excluding all processes from the tunnel
op.custom-list.list: Show all custom lists or retrieve a specific custom list
op.log.set-level: Set the log level of the daemon
op.log.set-rust-log: Set the log level of the daemon, using the `RUST_LOG` format.
op.log.listen: Follow live updates to the daemon log file. Analogue to running `tail -f` on the daemon log file
op.dns.set.default: Use a default DNS server, with or without content blocking
op.dns.set.custom: Set a list of custom DNS servers
op.relay.set.location: Select a relay using country, city or hostname. The 'mullvad relay list' command shows the available relays and their geographical location
op.relay.set.custom-list: Set custom list to select relays from. Use the 'custom-lists list' command to show available alternatives
op.relay.set.provider: Set hosting provider(s) to select relays from. The 'list' command shows the available relays and their providers
op.relay.set.ownership: Filter relays based on ownership. The 'list' command shows the available relays and whether they're rented
op.relay.override.get: Show current custom fields for servers
op.relay.override.clear-all: Unset custom IPs for all servers
op.api-access.add.shadowsocks: Configure a custom Shadowsocks proxy to use as an API access method
op.anti-censorship.set.mode: Specify which anti-censorship method to use, if any
op.tunnel.set.daita-direct-only: Configure whether to enable DAITA direct only
op.tunnel.set.allowed-ips: Specify custom allowed IPs for WireGuard tunnels. Use comma-separated values of IPs and IP ranges in CIDR notation. A empty string resets to the default value, where all traffic is allowed, i.e. (0.0.0.0/0,::/0). For CIDR ranges, host bits must be zero (e.g., "10.0.0.0/24" is valid, "10.0.0.1/24" is not).
op.tunnel.set.rotation-interval: The key rotation interval. Number of hours, or 'any'
op.tunnel.set.rotate-key: Replace the WireGuard key with a new one
op.tunnel.set.ipv6: Enable or disable IPv6 in the tunnel
op.custom-list.edit.add: Add a location to some custom list
op.custom-list.edit.remove: Remove a location from some custom list
op.relay.set.entry.location: Location of entry relay. This can be 'any' or any location that is valid with 'set location', such as 'se got'
op.relay.set.entry.custom-list: Name of custom list to use to pick entry endpoint
op.relay.override.set.ipv4: Override entry IPv4 address for a given relay
op.relay.override.set.ipv6: Override entry IPv6 address for a given relay
op.relay.override.unset.ipv4: Remove overridden entry IPv4 address for the given server
op.relay.override.unset.ipv6: Remove overridden entry IPv6 address for the given server
bar.tip: Click for connection summary; right-click to open the full window.
operation.empty: No functions found. Try another term or select a section.
backend.retry: Unable to load VPN functions. Use Refresh to try again.
result.empty: Run the function to see the CLI output here.
confirm.keys: Enter confirms the focused button · Esc cancels · Tab switches buttons
